Implemented in cacheUsageFields (desktop/src/chat/cacheUsage.ts): a call that reports cachedInputTokens with no cacheMissInputTokens now contributes input-cached to a separately summed derivedMisses total, shown as "Uncached input tokens" with its provenance label ("… (input − cached; no provider counter)", or "(… loaded, derived)" in scoped mode). A reported miss counter stays authoritative, the derivation is skipped when cached > input (the value then stays "Not reported"), and nothing in the derived path feeds pairedHits/pairedInput, so the cache-hit ratio and its "of reported calls" suffix are unchanged. Module docstring documents the rule.

Design: aworkit.desktop_ui.evidence_inspector description extended with a dated "Derived uncached remainder (2026-10-04)" paragraph; docs/approval-cache-accounting.md gained the matching provider-difference paragraph.

Verification: `pnpm run check` (tsc --noEmit) in desktop/ is clean. The unit-test suite was NOT run — the user explicitly asked not to run tests — so the three new/updated cases in desktop/src/chat/cacheUsage.test.ts (derived remainder, partially derived labelling with an authoritative reported counter, and refusal to derive when cached > input) are written but unexecuted. Behaviour is deterministic pure formatting over the events map. Not verified live in the app: the frontend is embedded at compile time, so the field only changes after a frontend build plus app restart.

Investigation of chat.daf239b81f0214c8d0ba12826cf760d7134649ac (mimo-v2.6-pro) found the Run Details "Uncached input tokens" field reads "Not reported" on OpenAI-compatible providers that return only prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (Xiaomi MiMo, Qwen), while DeepSeek returns prompt_cache_hit_tokens plus prompt_cache_miss_tokens. Because both APIs count cached input inside prompt_tokens, the uncached remainder is exactly input - cached and can be shown labelled as derived arithmetic instead of missing, which makes cache figures comparable across providers.

Scope: desktop/src/chat/cacheUsage.ts (cacheUsageFields) plus its unit test. A reported counter stays authoritative; the derived total only fills in calls that reported cached input without a miss counter, only when cached <= input, and never feeds the cache-hit ratio denominator.

data.title: Run Details: derive labelled uncached input when a provider reports only cached tokens
